text:
maya-marketing: Quick experiment proposal: two pricing page variants that test (1) preset scenarios (Startup/Growth/Enterprise) in a tiny calculator and (2) copy for tier names (functional vs commitment). Goal: increase calc->demo conversions without adding friction.

 tom-growth: thumbs up. Variants: V-A presets visible + open calc; V-B presets visible + email on request only. Test CTA: 'Get my estimate' vs 'See plan & price'.

 li-ux: keep presets as single-click chips that populate fields. after result show 'Recommended for' + two CTAs: 'Start trial' and 'Request demo'. no email on first interaction.

 nick-sales: routing rule: estimate>=2500 OR company_size>=150 => tag as enterprise and route to AE queue. include preset_selected and estimate_breakdown in lead notes.

 chris-analytics: events: variant, preset_click, calc_submit, estimate_value, demo_request. I need baseline calc->demo rate from marketing. I'll run sample size calc tomorrow.

 maya-marketing: action items: li -> prod snippet by EOD, chris -> power calc, tom -> set experiment. aim canary Mon for 7-day run.
